answer: To raise the cost of cloned identities I open a 36-hour tide window and lock 400 spendable POA in a named escrow. I first publish a SHA-256 commitment to a 16-byte seed; HKDF then yields 18 one-time keys. Across the window I must carry a hash-chained bridge of 18 pulses, one every 120 minutes, each signed by the next key and sealed as a shale stratum leaf that binds the prior pulse hash and a peer-auditable work digest. Missing a pulse, reusing a key, or breaking the leaf chain slashes the lock entirely.
